comments:
Independent composition on Madhyamaka articulated around the presentation of the Two Truths according to a structure common to other authors such as rGya dmar ba, Gro lung pa, etc. The author support the Svātantrika orientation and criticizes followers of Candrakīrti. 

Its composition predates the author's commentary on the Madhyamakāloka (ID:4482), which mentions its title as "de kho na nyid kyi snying po." ((ID:7460), 481-482: 'di rnams kyi don kyi cha ni kho bos de kho na nyid kyi snying por rgya cher gtan la dbab pas 'dir ma spros te | legs par rtogs par 'dod pas de las blta bar bya'o ||) (The passage was identified by Jongbok Yi and is cited in [5ENG67Z7]: 81, n. 9).
If the commentary on the Madhyamakāloka (ID:4482) is the "'jug ngogs bsdus bar bstan la phab pa" mentioned in the commentary on the Madhyamakālaṃkāra (ID:4482), then the dBu ma de kho na nyid snying po also predates that work. It could possibly be the "shes rab gsum la 'jug pa" mentioned in the  commentary on the Madhyamakālaṃkāra (ID:4482).

This text could corresponds to either the short or large "bsdus pa" listed A khu ching shes rab rgya mtsho in his Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 523, No. 11321: [phya pa chos seng gi...] dbu ma'i bsdus pa che chung gnyis). The other work is not extant (ID:6568).

Detailed table of contents in [KYDHTU7S].
Discussion of the differences between (ID:6818) and (ID:4485) in [NFNVKZKZ].
